title: Georgian Language Benchmark Data
subtitle: Gold data for testing how well AI models know Georgian
description:
Evaluation items for the Georgian Language Benchmark on Kaggle, in five tasks: numbers (digits and words, cardinal and ordinal, in Georgian's base-20 system), verb morphology (who does what to whom, verb forms, preverbs), Georgian-to-English translation, cloze texts (fill gaps with the right word form) and grammar correction. All items were written by a native speaker and reviewed by a Georgian language specialist.

Files: numbers.csv, verbs.csv, translation.csv, cloze.yaml, correction.csv. In all files `|` separates alternative correct answers or multiple-choice options.

Code: https://github.com/georgekobaidze/georgian-language-benchmarks
